finalOutput:
Created `todo_ollama-mimo-v2.6-flash-rl-mxfp4_01.html` — a single self-contained HTML file with all CSS and JS inline.

**Features implemented:**
- **Add** — text input + "Add" button (or press Enter)
- **Complete** — checkbox or click the text; completed items get strikethrough and muted color
- **Delete** — ✕ button on each todo
- **Filters** — All / Active / Completed pills with active-state styling
- **Persistence** — todos saved to `localStorage` under a namespaced key, loaded and validated (with graceful fallback) on startup
- Extras: remaining-items counter, empty state, XSS-safe rendering via `textContent`, keyboard-friendly focus handling
